//: Internal packages export TypeScript SOURCE directly (see CLAUDE.md), so a dependent's typecheck, lint and tests all read their dependencies' .ts files. With no `dependsOn`, turbo's default inputs are the package's own files only — a type change in packages/* could not invalidate a cached result in apps/*, and `pnpm -w typecheck` reported 24/24 while apps/api had a genuine cross-package type error. `^typecheck` puts the dependency's hash into the dependent's, which is what closes that.
